generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of veterinary examination (宠物医院诊疗). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Photograph a calm modern veterinary consultation room from the doorway. A veterinary surgeon gently examines one small dog on the central examination table; one front paw has a neat bandage, and the hands do not obscure the animal. Arrange the otoscope, microchip scanner, capped vaccination syringe and medicine dropper separately on a stainless tray. Put the digital pet scale on the floor at left, the empty travel crate at right and an Elizabethan collar hanging from a wall peg above. Soft clinical daylight, reassuring mood, no procedure in progress, no blood and no readable screen text.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: veterinary surgeon, veterinary examination table, digital pet scale, veterinary otoscope, pet microchip scanner, Elizabethan collar, animal vaccination syringe, paw bandage, medicine dropper, pet travel crate.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
